cin_inspection.cin_status: Where the inspection is: Draft, In progress, Submitted (waiting for review), Approved or Rejected.
cin_inspection.cin_score: Overall score from 0 to 100. Higher is better.
cin_inspection.cin_summary: The inspector's written summary of the visit.
cin_inspection.cin_requiresfollowup: Yes when a re-visit is needed.

cin_inspectionitem.cin_category: Kind of finding: Safety, Electrical, Fire, Structural or Housekeeping.
cin_inspectionitem.cin_severity: How serious it is: Info, Minor, Major or Critical.
cin_inspectionitem.cin_passed: No means the check failed, so it is a finding.
cin_inspectionitem.cin_notes: The inspector's notes about the item.
cin_inspectionitem.cin_resolvedon: Date the finding was fixed. Empty means still open.

cin_site.cin_risklevel: Low, Medium or High. High-risk sites are visited more often.
